text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Haah... Damn it... They really stuck it out
'til the
very end.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She looks extremely tired. She had
yesterday off,
so it can't be from
overwork. When I ask her
what's wrong...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Nothing. I was just... looking at some
auction
online...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... And it was the official publisher...
so they
were all skilled sellers... Grrr...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Why... why do my little siblings... have
such
annoying hobbies?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nakayama Festa whispers to herself half
asleep.
Apparently, she was bidding on
an auction late
into the night.
